Get Neighbors of Vertices

get_neighbors.Rd

Retrieves a vector of all unique neighbors for a given set of vertices.

Usage

get_neighbors(object, vertices)

# S4 method for class 'ECGraph'
get_neighbors(object, vertices)

Arguments

object

An ECGraph object.

vertices

A character vector of vertex names.

Value

A character vector of unique neighbor names.

Methods (by class)

  • get_neighbors(ECGraph): Method for ECGraph objects.

Examples

edge_df <- data.frame(v1 = c("A", "B", "C"), v2 = c("B", "C", "D"))
ecg <- ECGraph(edge_df)
# Get neighbors of vertices A and C
get_neighbors(ecg, c("A", "C")) # Returns "B" and "D"
#> [1] "B" "D"
